key_insight: CatAI reuses modular physicochemical knowledge to guide catalyst discovery across mechanistically distinct reactions.
engineering_relevance: The framework connects property data to catalytic objectives, supporting computational screening and iterative experimental optimization.
method: Learn from 1.8 million structure–property relations using 30 physicochemical encoders.
Compose reusable encoders into task-specific catalyst prediction models.
Guide candidate screening and autonomous model–experiment feedback loops.
evidence_signal: CatAI reports 7.8% lower task-averaged prediction error than next-best models, a polymer-synthesis catalyst with 9× commercial-benchmark activity, and a Cu-based photocatalyst outperforming traditional Ni-based systems.
watch_item: Transferability beyond the evaluated reactions and practical scale-up remain unestablished in the abstract.
paper_title: Adaptive catalyst discovery emerges from composable scientific intelligence
